integrity: Companion standard-library Python checker constructs the exact chain complex, checks both boundary identities and natural symmetry chain maps, derives character multiplicities from 144 element traces. Independent mathematical review is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only rational homology representations for three unordered points on K3,4. The integral homology ranks and torsion were already given in An (2026). No new integral lattice, cohomology ring or homotopy classification. Equivalence to an unindexed published calculation remains possible.
title: Complete rational symmetry decomposition of three-particle homology on the utility-graph extension
